newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Products to open 32 restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Products to open 32 restaurants.

text.p: Consolidated Products Inc said Wednesday it will meet its goal of opening 32 company-operated Stake n Shake restaurants in fiscal 1997, which ends in September.

The company previously outlined plans to establish controlled unit development growth of 20 percent annually, a pace that would add nearly 300 company-operated Stake n Shake restaurants in the fiscal years 1998-2002.
Consolidated Products currently operates 225 Steak n Shake restaurants, including 49 franchised units, and 11 other specialty restaurants.
Its shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 16-7/8.
